com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Class Evaluator

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.Evaluator

  • public final class Evaluator
extends java.lang.Object
    Coordinates evaluation of an AI Config output by running a set of Judge instances.

    An Evaluator is attached to an AICompletionConfig or AIAgentConfig and invoked by managed AI types (plan 4). In v1.0, the evaluator returned by the config retrieval methods is always a noop that returns an empty list immediately.

    Instances are immutable and thread-safe.

      • evaluate

        public java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture<java.util.List<LDAITrackingTypes.JudgeResult>> evaluate(java.lang.String input,
                                                                                                      java.lang.String output)
        Runs all configured judges against the given input/output pair and returns their results.

        Judges are run sequentially in the order specified by the LDAIConfigTypes.JudgeConfiguration. Returns an empty list immediately when no judge configuration is present. Judges referenced in the configuration but absent from the judges map are skipped with a warning; this is not an error.

        This method does NOT call trackJudgeResult — that is the caller's responsibility.

        Parameters:
        input - the message history or prompt that was sent to the model
        output - the model's response to evaluate
        Returns:
        a completed future holding the list of judge results; never null
